english:
Casting a Barricade unleashes 3 <solar Solar Waves /> that travel up to 18.5 meters and have tracking capabilities.

The Waves deal <pve 480 /> <pvp [100] /> damage and apply <pve 60 /> <pvp [30] /> stacks of <solar Scorch />. Enemies <pve Hit /> <pvp [Killed] /> by the Waves leave behind a <solar Sunspot /> at their location.

<arc Thruster /> releases a <solar Solar /> Ball that explodes after ? seconds, releasing 4 of these Waves in an X-pattern.

// The source leaves the Thruster Solar Ball's explosion delay unknown; ? is retained.

source.text:
On Barricade Placement:
Unleashes 3 Tracking Solar Wave that travel up to 18.5 metres away.
Solar Waves deal 480 [100] damage and applies x60 [x30] Scorch.
Solar Waves spawn a Sunspot under the enemies on hit [kill].

On Thruster Usage:
Releases a Solar Ball that explodes after ? seconds, releasing 4 Solar Waves in an X-pattern, using the aforementioned info.
